content.text: I've completed my review of all restriction-bearing provisions in the Agreement.

input.quote: iii. Licensor hereby, subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement and provided that Licensee makes payments to Licensor as required under this Agreement, grants to Licensee a non-exclusive license to utilize Licensed Technology solely in the Field of Use and subject to the additional restrictions set forth below and otherwise in this License Agreement.
input.rationale: No non-compete or competing-products covenant binds us. Every restriction imposed on the Licensee is a scope-of-licence or IP-protection limit on use of the Licensor's own Licensed Technology, not a restraint on our business: the "Field of Use" definition (p0007) and grant (p0030) limit only how we may use the Platform; the "Additional Restrictions" (p0035, p0040-p0047, incl. the derivative-works bar at p0044) and the sub-licence bar (p0085) restrict only dealings in the Licensed Technology. Nothing prevents us from operating any business, licensing or building a competing FX platform, or trading through other venues or ECNs, and there is no exclusivity, minimum-volume or territory covenant (fees are volume-based only). The three-year post-term non-solicit (p0125) restricts hiring, not competition, and the Change of Control consent/competitor test (p0134) and Right of First Refusal (p0139) are assignment/exit controls — all reviewed under their own playbook rules, not NONCOMPETE. A field-of-use limit on the vendor's licensed software is the core priced bargain here, so deleting it would be disproportionate under this rule and is not the restraint this rule targets. Compliant with the preferred position; no redline proposed.
